I have never been at a ride when it was struck, I saw Storm Runner get struck once and I will say it is one of the scariest things I've ever seen, the bolt hit the top hat and surged all the way up to the station along the track, but thankfully no one at the ride was hurt and the ride was only down for an hour or two. That's why I don't understand why Kingda Ka is always down for so long when it gets struck, Storm Runner has been struck a couple of times that I can remember but has never been down for long afterwards.
<<<END_EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT id="dac05b3a311b1eee">>>
